**Recommendation:** Build Elasticsearch and Lucene skills via hands-on projects before applying; this role requires deep search-engine expertise you currently lack.

optimizedCVData.summary: Backend engineer with 11 years of experience designing and operating high-throughput data processing systems in Java, Kotlin, and Python. Experienced in leading cross-functional engineering teams, conducting code review, and driving large-scale service migrations from design through production. Returning from a planned family caregiving break, during which AWS certification and continued open-source contribution kept technical skills current.

bullets: Designed and operated the settlement service in Kotlin and Spring Boot, processing approximately 40 million events per day on Kafka with high reliability.
Reduced p99 latency of the payment status API from 480ms to 120ms by migrating hot reads from PostgreSQL to Redis, eliminating a critical database bottleneck.
Led a team of 4 engineers through a 9-month migration from a monolith to 6 independent services, coordinating technical design, code review, and delivery across the full lifecycle.
Maintained on-call responsibility for the payments platform and authored post-incident reviews for 14 production incidents, improving system observability and team response processes.
Built order and inventory services in Java and Spring, backed by PostgreSQL and RabbitMQ, supporting core retail transaction workflows.
Introduced contract testing practices that reduced integration bugs caught in staging by approximately one third, improving release confidence across teams.
Collaborated with cross-functional stakeholders to define service contracts and data schemas, contributing to more predictable API design across the platform.
Delivered internal web tooling for two client engagements using Java and JavaScript, working directly with stakeholders to gather requirements and iterate on solutions.
Contributed to full software delivery cycles from scoping through deployment, building foundational experience in backend service development.
Supported code review processes and participated in team knowledge-sharing practices under senior engineering mentorship.
Maintained technical currency by completing AWS Solutions Architect Associate exam preparation and participating in a Designing Data-Intensive Applications reading group.
Contributed small bug fixes to an open-source Kotlin library, sustaining hands-on coding practice and engagement with the open-source community.
Earned AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate certification (2024) during this period.

coverLetter:
Priya Raman
Toronto, Canada
priya.raman@example.com
+1 555 0176

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Elastic

Dear Hiring Manager,

Cutting p99 latency on a high-throughput payment API by moving hot reads from PostgreSQL to Redis taught me something that transfers directly to search relevance work: understanding why a system behaves the way it does at scale matters more than any single tool. Elastic's Search Relevance team is working on exactly that class of problem, and I want to be part of it.

My eleven years building Java and Kotlin services gives me a solid foundation for Elasticsearch's Java-first codebase. At Lumen Payments, I designed and ran a settlement service processing tens of millions of events daily on Kafka, which required careful attention to concurrency, data structure choices, and the kind of async, distributed collaboration your globally-distributed team practices every day. I also have hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and Redis as production data storage technologies, and I contributed bug fixes to an open-source Kotlin library during my career break, so I'm comfortable with code review workflows on GitHub and working with community contributors.

I'd welcome the chance to talk through how my background maps to the Search Relevance team's roadmap. I'm available for a conversation at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Priya Raman

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Senior Software Engineer, Priya Raman
applicationEmail.body:
Hi there,

After 11 years building high-throughput backend systems in Java and Kotlin, including a settlement service processing around 40 million events a day, I was drawn to this role by Elastic's reputation for engineering depth and the challenge of working on search infrastructure at scale. My background in performance-sensitive Java services, data structure design, and concurrent event processing maps directly to the kind of low-level systems work the Elasticsearch team does. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I am available for a conversation any weekday from 9 am to 5 pm ET and would welcome the chance to discuss how my background fits the team's needs.

Best regards,
Priya Raman

followUpEmail.subject: Following Up: Senior Software Engineer, Priya Raman
followUpEmail.body:
Hi there,

I wanted to follow up on my application from last week for the Senior Software Engineer role on the Elasticsearch team.

I am particularly drawn to the focus on building new search features and improving code maintainability. At Lumen Payments, I led a 9-month migration from a monolith to six services, keeping a team of four aligned on quality throughout. I would welcome the chance to discuss how that experience fits the team's needs.

Best regards,
Priya Raman
